"""Changes in pounds from one donation to the next."""


def pounds_changes(donations):
    """Return the change in pounds from each donation to the next: one entry for every neighbouring pair."""
    out = []
    for i in range(2, len(donations)):
        out.append(donations[i].pounds - donations[i - 1].pounds)
    return out


def biggest_rise(donations):
    """Return the largest increase between neighbours, or 0 when there is none."""
    rises = [c for c in pounds_changes(donations) if c > 0]
    return max(rises) if rises else 0


def largest_pounds(donations):
    """Return the largest pounds, or None when there are no donations."""
    values = [x.pounds for x in donations]
    return max(values) if values else None
